name: lx_dsh_peek
description: Read-only, no-input, light-themed LAN peek at active DSH sessions, plus host-injected font and full-pane conversation-width overrides for the official DSH UI (no patched DMG). HTTP bootstrap for the initial transcript and one multiplexed SSE for live deltas/events, live reasoning and tool calls, reconnect baseline hydration, bounded tail rendering with optional single-text-buffer terminal mode, background-command output, subagent-aware follow, completion flash, screen-wake fallback, 1/2/3/4 panes and orientation-aware layout.
author: llp
